description: What a pasted product link becomes, before anything is saved: its name and picture, how it earns (your Amazon Associates tag, a brand program that accepted you, or one to apply to), whether the workspace has it already, the link page collection it would join, and a word to comment for it. Show it, ask for the creator's own photo or video of it (posts never use the shop's), then product_post_create.

url.description: A product's page: Amazon, a brand's shop, anywhere

urls.description: Or several, for one post with up to 10 products

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
